source: lyrify-bench results/summary.md, section 'NPU timing re-validation (2026-11-03)'; numbers in results/npu_timing.json; reference code scripts/npu_timing.py, ctc_align.py

align_mode.summary: wav2vec2 CTC forced alignment of ALL lyric lines over the whole vocal stem in one Viterbi (S4) gives the line starts. The NPU Whisper segments only give the confidence: S2c windows placed by the segments are aligned on slices of the same emissions, and the song is accepted when enough line starts agree with S4.
align_mode.stem: UVR-MDX-NET-Voc_FT vocal stem (the phone's NPU separation), mono, 16 kHz

aligner.input: each window normalised to zero mean, unit variance (eps 1e-7)
aligner.output: log_softmax over the 32 classes, blank id 0, word separator '|'

emissions.rule: window k covers [25k, 25k + 30] s (the last one ends at the song end); keep frames [125, 1375) of each window, the first window from frame 0, the last window to its end; concatenate. Frame f of the result = f x 0.02 s of the song.

line_times.rule: one forced alignment (ctc_align.align_lines) of every lyric line over the concatenated emissions; text = uppercase letters A-Z and apostrophe per word, words and lines joined by '|'; line start = first frame of the line's first token x 0.02 s
line_times.offset_note: leave-one-song-out offset of S4 is +0.05 s; S4+off is no better, so none
line_times.line_without_letters: no CTC token: give it the next placed line's start (or the previous one's at the end); none occurred on set A
line_times.tolerance_note: no consensus fallback: the S4 times are used as they are. Mixing in Whisper-placed times (S3, S5 consensus at 1.0/1.5/2.0 s) made every metric worse with the NPU's coarse segments.

confidence.segments: NPU Whisper segments from the timestamp tokens (phone rule: text between two timestamps; text before the first starts at the chunk start; an open end becomes the chunk end), shifted by the chunk start; segments with no letter or digit dropped

segments_to_lines_S1.dp: monotonic beads: p lines to 1 segment (p <= 16) or 1 line to q segments (2 <= q <= 4); skips score 0
segments_to_lines_S1.gain: (len(x) + len(y)) / 2 * (sim - tau) / (1 - tau), sim = rapidfuzz fuzz.ratio / 100
segments_to_lines_S1.line_start: a bead's first line starts at the segment start; other lines of a 1-segment bead at start + (share of the bead's characters before them, each line counted as its length + 1) x segment duration
segments_to_lines_S1.unmatched_lines: interpolated by lyric word position between placed lines; before the first / after the last placed line 0.45 s per word

windows_S2c.rule: for each group of 6 lines [a, b): window from S1[a] - 5 s to S1[b] + 5 s (song end for the last group), at most 60 s, clipped to the song; align lines a-1 .. b (one context line each side) on the frames of the window sliced from the whole-song emissions; keep the starts of lines a .. b-1; a window under 1 s or too short for its text keeps S1 for its lines
windows_S2c.emissions: slices of the same whole-song emissions (no second wav2vec2 run)

confidence.agreement: share of lines with |S4 - S2c| <= 0.5 s

accept.monotonic_rule: share of consecutive S4 line starts that rise by at least 0.2 s
accept.threshold_note: middle of the widest gap between song agreements on set A (rejected: 0.65, 0.70; accepted from 0.89); picked without the reference times

stricter_option.note: the lowest threshold whose accepted lines reach 85% within 1 s; it also drops two songs at 0.89 (one good, one bad), so it rests on a 0.01 margin

align_mode.on_reject: the timing is unreliable (rejected songs on set A: 52%, 60% of lines within 1 s); treat it like a rejected song of the previous gate

large_song_guard.note: the global Viterbi stores frames x states back-pointers (int8): largest on set A 17357 x 3245 = 56 M cells
large_song_guard.fallback: if frames x states would exceed the app's memory budget, use the S2c times (windowed, same emissions) as the line starts; on set A they are within 1 point of S4 within 1 s (MAE 2.70 s against 1.97 s); keep the gate

expected_set_A.previous_method_for_comparison: whisper.cpp DTW words + NW + CTC consensus: 53/66/79% within 0.3/0.5/1.0 s, 9 of 12 accepted at 77% / 86% within 0.5 / 1.0 s

transcribe_mode.line_start: segment start (timestamp token, shifted by the chunk start) + offset_sec
transcribe_mode.offset_note: median of (segment start - nearest reference line start) over segment starts within 2.0 s of a line, negated; segments start early

decoder: unchanged: the phone loop as it is (no timestamp rules). The numbers above come from a laptop replica of exactly that loop.
